identity_scope: Pacific and Atlantic NEC members remain separate from North Equatorial parent family and eastward counter/undercurrents. Aleutian/Subarctic stays distinct from westward Alaskan Stream,north-slope current and North Pacific Current. No inherited depth or independently classified current body.
